title: A2P 10DLC Campaign Approval Best Practices - SMS marketing

facts.fact: A new A2P 10DLC Campaign vetting process went into effect on January 26, 2023.
facts.quote: On January 26, 2023, a new A2P 10DLC Campaign vetting process is going into effect.

facts.fact: From January 26, 2023, newly registered A2P Campaigns are subject to a manual vetting process.
facts.quote: Effective January 26, 2023, newly registered A2P Campaigns are subject to a manual vetting process.

facts.fact: The January 2023 vetting change does not apply to Toll-Free messaging.
facts.quote: This change does not apply to Toll-Free messaging.

facts.fact: Campaigns that involve forbidden use cases, such as cannabis or hate speech, will be rejected.
facts.quote: Forbidden Use Cases Will Result in Campaign Rejection
